newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: S&P rates World Marine's claims-paying BBB.
newsitem.headline: S&P rates World Marine's claims-paying BBB.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Corp said on Monday it assigned a BBB claims-paying ability rating to World Marine & General Insurances Proprietary Ltd (WM&G), a unit of The Broken Hill Proprietary Company Ltd (BHP).
S&P said the rating reflected the company's position as a small but soundly-structured general insurer within BHP.

"WM&G is of small absolute size, lacking critical mass or sound market position in its niche markets. However, these factors are moderated by the sourcing of premium income through protected business sources," S&P said in a statement.
S&P said WM&G's resources included access to BHP staff and an agreement with a large friendly society, forming a stable portfolio of personal lines business base.
"WM&G's business profile is enhanced by its high level of integration with its 70 percent shareholder, BHP Marine and General Insurances Pty Ltd, and with BHP's operatons," S&P said.
S&P said WM&G's management was committed to maintaining a strong level of capitalisation and to cautious underwriting.

"Underwriting performance has been slightly worse than industry averages, although an improving trend is apparent. Earnings performance is satisfactory with return on equity averaging about 8.5 percent in each of the past four years," S&P said.
Standard & Poor's expects WM&G profit after tax to remain steady at about A$1.4-1.5 million in fiscal 1997.
"Personal lines premium volumes should remain stable, while a slight decline in commercial lines premium volumes is expected as a result of the soft commercial market conditions", S&P said.
